ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

6. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 10
   C. 8
   D. 11

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

9. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

12. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. B — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
